title: Migrate from GitHub Actions
summary: Converts a repository's GitHub Actions workflows into Infrawrench CI pipelines, job by job, and reports what could not move.
description: Convert GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/*.yml) into Infrawrench CI pipelines (.infrawrench/ci/*.yml). Use when asked to move a repository's CI from GitHub Actions to Infrawrench CI, or to translate a workflow, job, step or action into Infrawrench CI.
